pages.source_title: The EU (still) wants to scan your private messages and photos.

Internet Archive was hacked today, all 31 million accounts have had their details leaked. If you have an account it's *highly* recommended to change your password on the site, as well as anywhere else you are using the same login details.
Android will become a locked-down platform in less than 200 days.
